name: webular
description: Web research for agents, built on Jev (TypeSafe's System One decision model) and Mastra: search the web, read a page as Markdown, map a site, and summarize text, through typed MCP tools and four skills: research, interview, plain language, and Markdown. It runs on your machine, follows robots.txt by default, and works without a key; Jev's key is the only one.
